Class UIElementBuilder<T extends UIElementBuilder<T>>

java.lang.Object
au.ellie.hyui.builders.UIElementBuilder<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
BackgroundSupported<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
ActionButtonBuilder, BlockSelectorBuilder, ButtonBuilder, CheckBoxBuilder, CodeEditorBuilder, ColorPickerBuilder, ColorPickerDropdownBoxBuilder, ContainerBuilder, CustomButtonBuilder, DropdownBoxBuilder, DynamicImageBuilder, DynamicPaneBuilder, DynamicPaneContainerBuilder, FloatSliderBuilder, FloatSliderNumberFieldBuilder, GroupBuilder, HotkeyLabelBuilder, ImageBuilder, ItemGridBuilder, ItemIconBuilder, ItemSlotBuilder, ItemSlotButtonBuilder, LabelBuilder, LabeledCheckBoxBuilder, MenuItemBuilder, NativeTabButtonBuilder, NativeTabNavigationBuilder, NativeTimerLabelBuilder, NumberFieldBuilder, PageOverlayBuilder, PanelBuilder, ProgressBarBuilder, ReorderableListBuilder, ReorderableListGripBuilder, SceneBlurBuilder, SliderBuilder, SliderNumberFieldBuilder, SpriteBuilder, TabContentBuilder, TabNavigationBuilder, TextFieldBuilder, TimerLabelBuilder, ToggleButtonBuilder
public abstract class UIElementBuilder<T extends UIElementBuilder<T>> extends Object implements BackgroundSupported<T>
A builder class for constructing UI elements with a hierarchical structure and configurable properties. The UIElementBuilder class provides an API for specifying attributes such as styles, visibility, children, tooltips, custom callbacks, and more. This class is intended to be extended and further customized.
